headline: A Temporary Train Station for Roskilde Festival / Royal Danish Academy
context: For eight days every summer, a field outside Roskilde becomes Denmark's fourth-largest city. More than 125,000 people arrive by train, passing through a temporary piece of infrastructure that serves as both a transport hub and the front door to the festival.
